The plate looks like scrambled egg whites, or possibly crumbled soft cheese. The pale, fluffy, slightly translucent pieces fit egg whites best.

The plate is roughly 25 cm across and the pile covers about a third of it. I estimate the portion at about 150 g.

Cooked egg whites have about 52 kcal per 100 g, so 150 g comes to roughly 78 kcal. If it were cooked with butter, the figure would be somewhat higher, so I'll round up slightly.
